open_items.description: Validar métricas reais Gemini API com GEMINI_API_KEY antes do Week 3 — p50 ~1800ms e p95 ~4200ms são estimativas de dry runs sem API key real
SprintPlanArtifact e CodeReviewArtifact schemas não definidos no prd-artifact.json — SM define SprintPlanArtifact neste documento; CodeReviewArtifact deve ser definido pelo Dev antes do stage Review

weeks.theme: Foundation — Cargo Workspace, ensi-core Domain, ensi-db Schema

tasks.title: Cargo workspace scaffold + CI
tasks.description: Inicializar Cargo workspace com 8 crates (ensi-core, ensi-db, ensi-events, ensi-pipeline, ensi-server, ensi-daemon, ensi-frontend, ensi-cli). Configurar GitHub Actions (cargo check, cargo test, cargo clippy). Workspace compila sem erros.

tasks.title: ensi-core: entidades de domínio
tasks.description: Definir structs Rust para todas as entidades: Workspace, Member, Agent, Project, Issue, PipelineState, Task, TaskMessage, Artifact, Comment, PAT, DaemonToken. Seguir naming snake_case. Sem I/O, sem frameworks — apenas tipos puros e error types (thiserror).

tasks.title: ensi-core: port traits (hexagonal inner layer)
tasks.description: Definir traits async: IssueRepository, ProjectRepository, WorkspaceRepository, MemberRepository, AgentRepository, TaskRepository, ArtifactRepository, PipelineRepository, EventPublisher, AgentExecutor, ArtifactStore. Todos com Result<_, CoreError>.

tasks.title: ensi-db: SurrealDB 3.0 embedded init + SCHEMAFULL schema
tasks.description: Inicializar SurrealDB 3.0 em modo embedded (~/ensi_data/). Definir SCHEMAFULL schema para as 12 tabelas: workspace, member, agent, project, issue, pipeline_state, task, task_message, artifact, comment, pat, daemon_token. Verificar startup sem erros. DB health check no boot.

weeks.theme: Foundation — NATS, Auth, Axum Base, OI-001 Validation

tasks.title: ensi-events: NATS JetStream embedded + EventPublisher adapter
tasks.description: Inicializar NATS JetStream em modo embedded. Definir hierarquia de subjects: ensi.task.created, ensi.task.{task_id}.message, ensi.task.{task_id}.completed, ensi.task.{task_id}.failed, ensi.pipeline.{issue_id}.transition, ensi.issue.{issue_id}.updated. Implementar EventPublisher trait.

tasks.title: ensi-server: Axum 0.8 base + auth middleware (JWT/PAT/DaemonToken)
tasks.description: Setup Axum 0.8 com AppState (db, events, config). Graceful shutdown. Middleware de autenticação: extrai Bearer token, detecta tipo (JWT HS256, PAT ens_*, DaemonToken edt_*), resolve identidade, anexa a request extensions. JWT exp 24h, PAT bcrypt, DaemonToken exp task TTL+1h.

tasks.title: ensi-server: endpoints de auth (/auth/login, /auth/me, /auth/pat)
tasks.description: Implementar: POST /auth/login (email+password → JWT), GET /auth/me (identidade autenticada), POST /auth/pat (criar PAT ens_*), GET /auth/pat (listar PATs), DELETE /auth/pat/:id (revogar). PAT stored como bcrypt hash.

tasks.title: OI-001 — Validar métricas reais Gemini API (GEMINI_API_KEY) — BLOCKING para Week 3
tasks.description: BLOCKER CRÍTICO: Executar spike SP-01 com GEMINI_API_KEY real. Testar gemini-2.0-flash (Discovery/Development/Review) e gemini-2.5-pro (Planning/Architecture) em todos os 5 stages. Medir p50/p95 latência e qualidade de structured output. Se problemas encontrados: avaliar fallbacks (gemini-1.5-pro, prompt adjustment, schema simplification). RESULTADO OBRIGATÓRIO antes do fim da Week 2 — se falhar, paralysa toda Week 3 (T-009 a T-012 não iniciam até resolução ou escalation). Atualizar architecture-artifact.json com métricas e recomendações reais.

tasks.title: ensi-db: adapters IssueRepository, ProjectRepository, WorkspaceRepository, MemberRepository
tasks.description: Implementar os 4 adapters SurrealDB. CRUD completo com SurrealDB queries typed. Filtros em IssueRepository: status, priority, assignee, limit/offset (pagination: total + has_more). Indexes respeitados. Tests de integração para cada adapter.

tasks.title: ensi-db: adapters AgentRepository, TaskRepository, ArtifactRepository, PipelineRepository
tasks.description: Implementar os 4 adapters restantes. ArtifactRepository: salvar/recuperar data (object field) sem overhead de serialização. PipelineRepository: update atômico de stage + stage_status + retry_count. TaskRepository: filtro por status para daemon polling.

tasks.title: ensi-server: Workspace, Member, Project REST endpoints
tasks.description: Implementar: GET/POST /workspaces, GET /workspaces/:id, GET/POST /workspaces/:id/members, POST /workspaces/:id/members/invite, GET/POST /workspaces/:id/projects, GET /projects/:id. Response format: JSON com pagination wrapper onde aplicável.

tasks.title: ensi-server: Agent REST endpoints
tasks.description: Implementar: GET/POST /workspaces/:id/agents, GET /agents/:id, PATCH /agents/:id. Agent slug unique por workspace (UNIQUE idx_agent_ws_slug). Error format padronizado: {error: {code, message, details}}.

weeks.theme: Core — Issues API, Comments, Daemon Bootstrap, Frontend Scaffold

tasks.title: ensi-server: Issue CRUD + Comment endpoints
tasks.description: Implementar: GET/POST /projects/:id/issues (com filtros status/priority/assignee/limit/offset e response total+has_more), GET/PATCH/DELETE /issues/:id, GET/POST /issues/:id/comments, DELETE /comments/:id. issue.number auto-incrementado via project.issue_counter.

tasks.title: ensi-daemon: task poller + execenv lifecycle
tasks.description: Implementar subscriber NATS ensi.task.created. Para cada task: criar execenv em ~/ensi_workspaces/{ws_id}/{task_id}/, injetar context files (AGENT.md com persona, ISSUE.md com título/desc/comments, PIPELINE.md com state e artifact summaries, REPOS.md com repo paths). Polling interval 3000ms. Cleanup do execenv após conclusão.

tasks.title: ensi-frontend: Leptos 0.7 SSR + WASM scaffold
tasks.description: Configurar trunk build com Axum-hosted Leptos SSR + WASM hydration. TailwindCSS via trunk/leptos-style. leptos_router com rotas: /, /login, /workspaces/:id, /projects/:id, /issues/:id. Login page funcional (POST /auth/login → JWT armazenado). WASM budget: verificar < 500 KB gzipped no build.

weeks.theme: Pipeline — FSM, WebSocket Hub, Issue Board, Artifact Endpoints

tasks.title: ensi-pipeline: FSM + artifact validation
tasks.description: Implementar Pipeline FSM: estados (Idle, Discovery, Planning, Architecture, Development, Review, Blocked, Complete), transições com guards (artifact schema-valid, retry_count < 3), eventos (pipeline_started, artifact_validated, max_retries_exceeded, retry_reset). FSM chama AgentExecutor via trait. FSM só vê sucesso ou max_retries_exceeded — retry loop encapsulado no AgentExecutor.

tasks.title: ensi-server: WebSocket hub + pipeline/task REST endpoints
tasks.description: WebSocket hub em /ws: broadcast de task.started, task.message, task.completed, task.failed, pipeline.transition, issue.updated. Endpoints: GET /issues/:id/pipeline, POST /issues/:id/pipeline/start, POST /issues/:id/pipeline/unblock, GET /issues/:id/tasks, GET /tasks/:id, GET /tasks/:id/messages (params: limit, since_seq), GET/GET /issues/:id/artifacts, GET /artifacts/:id.

tasks.title: ensi-frontend: Issue Board (click-to-move) com WebSocket
tasks.description: Issue Board com 5 colunas (todo, in_progress, in_review, done, blocked). Click em issue → dropdown para mover de coluna (ADR-005: sem DnD). WebSocket resource Leptos para live updates (issue.updated → refresh card). Leptos signals para state management. Borrow-checker: clone-before-capture em closures.

weeks.theme: BMad — AgentExecutor (Gemini), Daemon Tokens, Pipeline View, CLI

tasks.title: ensi-daemon: AgentExecutor — Gemini API calls + retry loop
tasks.description: Implementar AgentExecutor trait: model_for_stage() → gemini-2.0-flash (Discovery/Development/Review) ou gemini-2.5-pro (Planning/Architecture). execute(): schema preprocessing (strip additionalProperties, $ref, oneOf, anyOf), chamada Gemini structured output, validação JSON Schema, retry loop max 3 com error injection (validation_error no prompt). NATS publish de task.message por stream. NFR: p95 < 5min por stage.

tasks.title: ensi-daemon: DaemonToken lifecycle + daemon REST endpoints
tasks.description: Emitir edt_* token por task (exp = task TTL + 1h, stored como hash em daemon_token table). Integrar daemon endpoints: POST /daemon/tasks/:id/messages (append task_message + NATS publish), PUT /daemon/tasks/:id/status (completed|failed → update task + publish), POST /daemon/tasks/:id/artifacts (submit artifact validado + trigger pipeline transition). Auth: DaemonToken middleware.

tasks.title: ensi-frontend: Pipeline View + Issue Detail + Task Feed
tasks.description: Pipeline View: 5 stage cards com status indicators (pending/running/done/failed/blocked) e pipeline.transition via WebSocket. Artifact Inspector panel: renderizar JSON blob do artifact (BriefArtifact, PrdArtifact, ArchitectureArtifact, SprintPlanArtifact) em formato legível. Issue Detail: task feed com mensagens live (role-based: assistant/tool_use/tool_result/system) via WebSocket task.message.

tasks.title: ensi-cli: comandos de workspace, issue, pipeline e PAT
tasks.description: Implementar CLI com clap: workspace (create, list), project (create, list), issue (create, list, get, update, delete), pipeline (start, unblock, status), pat (create, list, revoke). Output: JSON ou table (flag --output). Autenticação via PAT env var ENSI_TOKEN. Binary: ensi.

weeks.theme: Polish — OI-001 Validation, Error Handling, Task Feed UI, Integration Tests

tasks.title: OI-001 — Validação end-to-end do pipeline completo
tasks.description: Rodar pipeline Discovery→Planning→Architecture→Development→Review com GEMINI_API_KEY real e issue representativo. Medir p95 por stage e pipeline total. Verificar NFR-01 (p95 < 5min para Analyst) e NFR-02 (p95 < 20min pipeline completo). Documentar resultados. Se NFR violado: escalar para ajuste de modelo ou schema simplification.

tasks.title: Error handling hardening + Blocked state UI
tasks.description: Respostas de erro estruturadas em todos os endpoints (código + message + details). AgentExecutor: exponential backoff para erros transientes Gemini (NFR-06: máx 3 retries). Pipeline Blocked: comment automático na issue explicando falha. Frontend: exibir estado Blocked com motivo no Pipeline View. Garantir que API keys nunca aparecem em logs (NFR-07).

tasks.title: ensi-frontend: Agent Task Feed view completo
tasks.description: View dedicada para feed de mensagens de uma task (role-based coloring: assistant=azul, tool_use=laranja, tool_result=verde, system=cinza). Polling incremental via GET /tasks/:id/messages?since_seq=N. Auto-scroll em novo message. Indicador de status (running/completed/failed) com timestamp.

tasks.title: Suite de testes de integração
tasks.description: Pipeline FSM: testes unitários para todas as transições e guards. SurrealDB adapters: testes de integração com DB embedded (round-trips CRUD). Axum endpoints: testes de integração com TestClient (auth, CRUD, error codes). WASM budget: asserção automática no CI que gzipped WASM < 500 KB.

weeks.theme: Ship — Security, Single Binary, Docs, Release

tasks.title: Security audit
tasks.description: Verificar: JWT secret rotation documentado, PAT bcrypt verification testado, DaemonToken expiry enforcement com test, API keys nunca em logs/artefacts (grep no codebase), nenhum PII em artefatos além do input do usuário (NFR-08), sem telemetria third-party (NFR-09). Corrigir achados antes do release.

tasks.title: Single binary validation + release build
tasks.description: cargo build --release para macOS (aarch64 + x86_64) e Linux (x86_64). Verificar: SurrealDB embedded init sem process externo, NATS embedded init, Leptos SSR servido do mesmo binário, CLI incluso. Medir startup time < 3s. Smoke test: login → criar workspace → criar projeto → criar issue → start pipeline.

tasks.title: Documentação — README, quickstart, API reference, CHANGELOG
tasks.description: README.md: install (cargo install ensi ou binary download), quickstart (5 steps da criação de workspace ao primeiro artifact), pré-requisitos (GEMINI_API_KEY, sem serviços externos). API reference: endpoints com exemplos curl. CHANGELOG v1.0. CLAUDE.md por crate para onboarding de dev agents. Referência aos ADRs.

tasks.title: GitHub Release v1.0
tasks.description: Tag v1.0 no repositório. GitHub Release com binários para macOS aarch64, macOS x86_64, Linux x86_64. Release notes do CHANGELOG. Smoke test final contra environment limpo. Anunciar para workspace Multica.

milestones.name: Foundation complete
milestones.gate: Cargo workspace compila (cargo check sem erros), SurrealDB embedded up com schema SCHEMAFULL, NATS JetStream embedded up, auth middleware (JWT/PAT/DaemonToken) funcional, OI-001 resolvido (métricas Gemini reais documentadas)

milestones.name: Core complete
milestones.gate: Todos os endpoints REST funcional (workspaces, projects, issues, comments, agents, auth), ensi-db adapters completos com testes, daemon recebe task via NATS e cria execenv, Leptos app faz login e exibe issues

milestones.name: Pipeline complete
milestones.gate: FSM roda pipeline completo Discovery→Planning→Architecture→Development→Review com Gemini real, artifacts validados por schema, WebSocket broadcast funcional, Pipeline View e Task Feed visíveis no browser, CLI ensi operacional

milestones.name: Ship
milestones.gate: Single binary macOS+Linux, docs completos, security audit aprovado, release build < 3s startup, GitHub Release v1.0 publicado

risks.risk: Gemini API latency real excede estimativas — p95 > 5min para Analyst ou > 20min para pipeline completo
risks.mitigation: OI-001 validação no final da Week 2 (T-008). Se NFR violado: simplificar schema de artifacts para reduzir tokens de output, ou fallback gemini-2.0-flash para Planning/Architecture como último recurso.

risks.risk: SurrealDB 3.0 embedded instabilidade — crash ou corrupção de dados em queries complexas
risks.mitigation: SCHEMAFULL mode para detectar violações cedo (T-004). DB health check no boot do server. Se instabilidade confirmada na Week 3: avaliar downgrade para SurrealDB 2.x ou pivot para SQLite + serde_json para artifact blobs.

risks.risk: Leptos reactive model causa slip de schedule — dev novo ao modelo reactivo do Leptos
risks.mitigation: 3-4 dias de onboarding no início da Week 4 (incluídos na estimativa T-015). Começar com componentes Leptos estáticos antes de adicionar reatividade. LOC ~30% maior que Next.js equivalente — budget de estimativas ajustado.

risks.risk: NATS JetStream embedded sem precedente em produção na stack Rust — API instável ou behavior inesperado
risks.mitigation: Implementação isolada em ensi-events (T-005) com testes de integração na Week 2. Se API unstable: fallback para polling SurrealDB em vez de NATS pub/sub — impacta só ensi-daemon e ensi-server.

risks.risk: Gemini structured output falha schema validation > 15% das chamadas — success rate < 85%
risks.mitigation: ADR-003: retry loop com error injection (3 tentativas). Schema preprocessing (strip additionalProperties/$ref/oneOf/anyOf) reduz falhas. Se taxa persistir alta: simplificar schemas de artifact removendo constraints complexos.
